title: Support contained in a set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\iota$ be a type with decidable equality, choose $z\in\iota$, and let $a:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\iota$. For any set $J$ of positions, every position $i$ with $a(i)\ne z$ belongs to $J$ if and only if $a(i)=z$ for every position $i$ outside $J$.
